Markets.title: Fed survey shows continued growth and sticky inflation in recent weeks
Markets.summary: Recent Federal Reserve surveys show the U.S. economy experiencing modest growth alongside persistent inflation and rising business expenses. This economic climate has prompted the Federal Reserve to consider potential adjustments to interest rates.

Markets.title: Copper slumps to lowest in 11 months as investors flee
Markets.summary: Copper prices on the London Metal Exchange fell to their lowest level in over 11 months amid a broader market retreat from technology and artificial intelligence stocks. Prices for other metals, including tin and aluminum, also experienced sharp declines due to ongoing investor uncertainty.

Markets.title: Carlyle pares 7.4% stake in Piramal Pharma for over Rs 2,211 crore
Markets.summary: The Carlyle Group sold a 7.4 percent stake in Piramal Pharma for over Rs 2,211 crore through an open market deal. Following the transaction, which reduced Carlyle's holding to 10.52 percent, Piramal Pharma's share price dropped.

Markets.title: RBI raises share of domestically held gold reserves, data shows
Markets.summary: As of September, the Reserve Bank of India increased its domestic gold holdings to 740.13 metric tonnes out of a total 880.52 metric tonnes. Despite this addition, gold's share of India's total $705.3 billion in foreign exchange reserves decreased to 14.38%.

Markets.title: Two in five Indian family offices, UHNIs have engaged with crypto amid regulatory caution
Markets.summary: About 41 percent of high-net-worth investors and family offices in India are investing in cryptocurrencies despite having only a basic understanding of the market. Regulatory uncertainty remains a major concern, leading 59 percent of these investors to rely on informal channels like social media and peer networks for information.

Markets.title: RBI net buyer of dollars for fourth straight month in September, data shows
Markets.summary: In September, the Reserve Bank of India bought a net $6.94 billion in foreign currency, marking its fourth consecutive month as a net dollar buyer. Meanwhile, capital inflows reached approximately $143 billion, driven by rising investments in Indian equities and various economic measures.

Geo-Political.title: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
Geo-Political.summary: The United States has announced new tariffs impacting major trading partners such as China and the European Union. These new levies are designed to target a wide range of foreign goods entering the American market.

Geo-Political.title: Images of asteroid targeted to test Earth's defences reveal stadium-sized crater
Geo-Political.summary: New images reveal a stadium-sized crater on the surface of an asteroid. A spacecraft was deliberately crashed into the asteroid four years ago to test Earth's planetary defense capabilities.

Geo-Political.title: Thirty-one killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway
Geo-Political.summary: A fuel tanker crashed and overturned on a busy ring road in Cairo, Egypt. The resulting massive fire killed 31 people and injured 21 others.

Geo-Political.title: Israeli judges recommend dropping most serious charges against Netanyahu
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli judges have recommended dropping the most serious bribery charges against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in one of his three corruption cases. Netanyahu stated that his ongoing trial should now be completely dismissed.

Geo-Political.title: US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify
Geo-Political.summary: US stock markets declined further in early trading, driven by growing anxieties surrounding artificial intelligence. The technology-focused Nasdaq index experienced the heaviest losses, falling by nearly 4%.

Geo-Political.title: US Army says controlled blast of explosives in Iowa was 'huge success'
Geo-Political.summary: The US Army declared a controlled explosion of explosives in Iowa a major success despite prior concerns from local residents. Officials reported that initial lead readings in the surrounding area have remained promising.

AI & Tech.title: REA: The Open-Source AI Tool That Can Reverse Engineer Almost Anything (2026 Guide)
AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool that allows users to understand how applications work without accessing their source code. The tool eliminates the need for months of learning disassemblers and reading assembly code by providing evidence-backed answers through an AI assistant.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their SaaS WordPress course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This unexpected AI recommendation occurred without the use of paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

Data & Insights.title: India’s Q2 GDP growth to slow marginally to 7.6%, shows Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: India's Q2 GDP growth is expected to slow marginally to 7.6%, according to a Mint poll. While resilient manufacturing and services activity supported the economy, a deficient monsoon and uneven rural demand weighed on growth.

Data & Insights.title: India rejects US' structural excess capacity allegations as Washington links 17% tariff to trade deal, 25% otherwise
Data & Insights.summary: India has rejected US allegations of structural excess capacity, stating that no such surplus exists in any sector. Meanwhile, Washington has proposed a 17% tariff if both nations reach a bilateral trade deal, or 25% if an agreement is not met.

Data & Insights.title: US proposes extra tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods, 17% after trade deal
Data & Insights.summary: The US Trade Representative proposed additional tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods, which could be reduced to 17% if a proposed trade deal is signed. This policy impacts the US as India's largest export market, where goods shipments exceeded $87 billion in the fiscal year through March 2026.

Data & Insights.title: RBI shifts more gold home amid geopolitical uncertainty
US targets India, China, EU with new tariffs citing overcapacity
Data & Insights.summary: The United States is implementing new tariffs on India, China, and the European Union due to concerns over global overcapacity. Indian exports could face an immediate 17% tariff under a potential trade agreement, with the rate possibly rising to 25%.

Data & Insights.title: India stands out amid uneven global growth, says RBI bulletin
Data & Insights.summary: According to an RBI bulletin, India's economy is growing strongly due to robust consumption, credit growth, and exports. However, the overall outlook remains clouded by geopolitical tensions, high energy prices, and global financial market volatility.

India.title: Highway Authority's New Plan To Help Motorists After Accidents, Breakdowns
India.summary: The National Highways Authority of India is launching emergency response teams to assist motorists following accidents and vehicle breakdowns. These teams will coordinate with the 1033 helpline, local police, fire services, and hospitals.

India.title: 'Koi Cinema Thodi Hai': Anant Singh Turns Daughter's Wedding Into Fair
India.summary: Bihar strongman Anant Singh turned his daughter's wedding into a massive fair featuring a racing ground. He also had a special helipad built at the venue to accommodate VIP guests.

India.title: Supreme Court's Deepam Order Flouted, How TVK Approach Differs From MK Stalin
India.summary: A preliminary status report filed by the Madurai Collector in the Supreme Court blames the temple administration's Board of Trustees for failing to execute a Deepam order. The report highlights how this non-compliance contrasts the approach of Vijay's TVK with that of Tamil Nadu Chief Minister MK Stalin.

India.title: India's 1st Private-Built PSLV Rocket Delayed Again: What Is Holding Up The ₹860-Crore Project?
India.summary: India's first privately-built PSLV rocket project, valued at ₹860 crore, has faced another delay according to an announcement by ISRO Chairman V Narayanan. The revised timeline for the mission was revealed during the India International Space Conclave in New Delhi.

General.title: Stalking law simplified to become one offence
General.summary: A new single stalking offence is being introduced to replace existing laws. This change follows a review that found the current legislation too confusing.

General.title: US approves SpaceX plan to send a million data satellites to space
General.summary: The US government has approved SpaceX's plan to launch the Starmind constellation, which will consist of a million data satellites. This network aims to provide a cost-effective and energy-efficient solution to meet the rapidly growing demand for artificial intelligence computing power.

General.title: Poundland collapses putting 11,000 jobs at risk
General.summary: Discount chain Poundland has entered administration after its owners were unable to secure a buyer. This collapse places 11,000 jobs at risk.

General.title: Expect fewer frosts and more hot days as UK seasons shift, says Met Office
General.summary: The Met Office reports that climate shifts are causing fewer frosts and an increase in hot days across the UK. These changing seasons are already impacting local wildlife and prompting farmers to alter their crop choices.

General.title: BBC launches partnership with Met Office for weather coverage
General.summary: The BBC has partnered with the Met Office to handle its weather forecasting. The agreement will provide audiences with more regional, digital, and 10-day forecasts.

General.title: Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor dies aged 65
General.summary: Andy Taylor, the guitarist and co-writer for the band Duran Duran, has died at the age of 65. He had been receiving treatment for prostate cancer.
